name: What is a backyard cottage and what are its potential uses?

mainEntity.name: What is a backyard cottage and what are its potential uses?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backyard cottage, often referred to as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or a detached accessory structure, is a secondary dwelling on the same property as a single-family home. These structures can serve various purposes, from providing a private space for adult children or aging parents to functioning as a dedicated home office, a gym, or even a rental unit for additional income. AKN Design Group specializes in designing and building these additions to seamlessly integrate with your existing property, enhancing its functionality and long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A backyard cottage is a secondary dwelling on a property, usable as a private living space, home office, gym, or rental unit, enhancing property functionality.
